user.title: Connect to your Network OWL
user.description: All communication stays on your LAN. The UDP key is shown in the OWL Intuition dashboard under System → Advanced Settings → Data Push.

data_description.push_host: The Network OWL will push readings to this address. Pre-filled with this Home Assistant's IP.
data_description.multicast: Only needed for Network OWLs that broadcast on 224.192.32.19. Off by default.

error.cannot_connect: No response from the Network OWL. Check the IP address and the UDP key (a wrong key produces no reply).
error.invalid_key: The UDP key must be 7 or 8 hexadecimal characters.
error.push_config_failed: The Network OWL answered but refused the push configuration.

abort.already_configured: This Network OWL is already configured.

no_data.title: No readings from the Network OWL
no_data.description: Home Assistant has not received readings from {name} for more than 5 minutes. Check that the transmitter is paired (blue LED flashing every 12–60 s), that the Network OWL is on the LAN, and that nothing blocks UDP port {port} on this host.

clock_not_synced.title: Network OWL clock could not be set
clock_not_synced.description: {name} rebooted and lost its clock, and the automatic clock sync failed. Daily energy totals will reset at the wrong time until the clock is set. Use the “Sync clock” button or check the UDP key.

command_failed.message: The Network OWL did not accept the command: {error}
